valuation.method: Forward Real Estate FFO per diluted share x P/FFO multiple (FY2027E Real Estate FFO viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Slower ~1% FFO growth on higher refinancing costs and macro retail softness
bear.assumption: FY2027E Real Estate FFO $13.50/sh at 15.0x P/FFO

base.driver: Steady ~4.5% FFO growth supported by 96.5% occupancy, +6.1% base minimum rent growth, and +6.7% portfolio NOI growth
base.assumption: FY2027E Real Estate FFO $13.95/sh at 17.5x P/FFO

bull.driver: Accelerated ~7.5% FFO growth from strong leasing spreads, outlet/mall traffic, and accretive redevelopment
bull.assumption: FY2027E Real Estate FFO $14.35/sh at 19.5x P/FFO

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E Real Estate FFO of $13.95/sh, the $232.97 close implies 16.7x P/FFO; the Street consensus average target (~$235.00) implies 16.8x P/FFO or $13.43/sh at 17.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/FFO moves the base target by $13.95 (6.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: U.S. Malls and Premium Outlets occupancy (96.5% in Q3 2026), base minimum rent per sq ft ($62.75), and constant-currency portfolio NOI growth (+6.7% YoY).
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 / FY2026 earnings release (expected early February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following SPG's Q3 2026 earnings release on November 5, 2026 (which raised FY2026 Real Estate FFO guidance to $13.30-$13.40/sh and lifted the quarterly dividend to $2.30/sh), Goldman Sachs raised its target to $260, UBS raised to $235, and Evercore ISI raised to $227, while Bank of America trimmed its target slightly to $260 (Buy). Street consensus (~$235) sits near the $232.97 close and ~4 pp below our $244.13 base case, reflecting Hold-rated caution after SPG's rally near 52-week highs.
